query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Analyze and triage Zendesk support tickets at scale: search ticket queues, enrich tickets with requester/order context, add private AI triage notes and tags, verify queues are drained, and aggregate product-support trends over a large historical ticket set.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Zendesk provides customer support software with ticketing, live chat, and knowledge base features, enabling efficient helpdesk operations and customer engagement
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=zendesk. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="zendesk") to create a connection BEFORE executing any zendesk tools.

ZENDESK_UPDATE_TICKETS_TAGS.description: Update tags on a Zendesk ticket via PUT request to /api/v2/tickets/{ticket_id}/tags. Use when you need to add, replace, or manage tags on an existing ticket. This operation replaces all existing tags with the provided list.

tags.description: An array of tag names to set on the ticket. Using this endpoint replaces all existing tags on the ticket with the provided tags.

ticket_id.description: The ID of the ticket to update tags for.

ZENDESK_GET_ZENDESK_TICKETS_TAGS.description: List all tags associated with a specific Zendesk ticket. Use when you need to retrieve the tags assigned to a particular ticket for categorization, filtering, or reporting purposes.

ticket_id.description: The numeric ID of the ticket whose tags to retrieve. Must be a non-null integer. Obtain from ZENDESK_LIST_ZENDESK_TICKETS, ZENDESK_GET_ZENDESK_TICKET_BY_ID, or other ticket-related actions.

ZENDESK_GET_ZENDESK_TICKET_BY_ID.description: Get ticket details from Zendesk. Returns the full ticket record (status, requester_id, assignee_id, organization_id, tags, custom_fields, created_at/updated_at, etc.) alongside its comments. Response wraps all data under a top-level `data` key; access `data['comments']` for comments and `data['comments'][i]['attachments']` for attachments (attachments unavailable from list endpoints). Each comment has both `html_body` and plain `body` fields — choose appropriately. Fields like `subject`, `organization_id`, `author_id`, and `body` may be null; handle defensively. First comment in `data.comments` is not necessarily from the requester — compare `author_id` against ticket `requester_id` to identify requester messages. For bulk calls, honor `Retry-After` headers on HTTP 429.

page.description: Page number for paginating through ticket comments (starts at 1). Zendesk returns up to 100 comments per page by default.

per_page.description: Number of comments to return per page (max 100). Use with 'page' to control pagination of ticket comments.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to get details for.
